answer: Every settled trade drops sediment onto an agent's identity file, packing into strata like shale: record replaces birthright, and deep history is what weighs. Reward rules then pay by strata depth, so a newborn key earns nothing until it accrues slow layers. Sybil fleets scatter wide and thin as a plume, each throwaway shell near-weightless at payout time. Bottleneck closes on the forger: building one walnut-dense past burns more stored work than any single fake will ever repay.
